error.enquiryNotAccepted: A contract can only be created from a request the professional has accepted.
error.notClient: Only the client of this contract can do this.
error.notProvider: Only the professional on this contract can do this.
error.notParty: Only the two parties of this contract can do this.
error.duplicateContract: This request already has a live contract.
error.invalidTransition: This action isn't possible in the contract's current state.
error.draftOnly: Stages can only be changed while the contract is a draft.
error.hourlyNoManualMilestones: An hourly contract is paid from approved timesheets, not from manually added stages.
error.hourlyRateRequired: An hourly contract needs an hourly rate and a weekly hours cap.
error.milestonesRequired: Add at least one stage before sending the contract.
error.milestonesMustSumToTotal: Stages must add up to the contract total ({total}).
error.milestoneNotFundable: This stage can't be paid in advance right now.
error.milestoneNotFunded: This stage has to be paid in advance before work is sent.
error.milestoneNotSubmitted: This stage hasn't been submitted for approval.
error.paymentUnavailable: Payment service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
error.heldFundsClientOnly: Advance payments are still on this contract. Only the client can cancel it; you can open a dispute instead.
error.submittedBlocksCancel: Approve or send back the submitted stages before cancelling.
error.notCompletable: Every advance-paid stage has to be released or refunded before the contract can be completed.
error.weekStartNotMonday: Week start must be a Monday.
error.weekInFuture: You can't submit hours for a week that hasn't started.
error.weeklyCapExceeded: Hours exceed this contract's weekly cap of {cap}.
error.timesheetDuplicateWeek: A timesheet for this week already exists.
error.budgetExceeded: This would exceed the contract's budget of {total}.
error.disputeAlreadyOpen: A dispute is already open on this contract.

outcome.resolved_client: resolved in the client's favour, advance payments refunded
outcome.resolved_provider: resolved in the professional's favour, advance payments released
outcome.closed: closed without a change, the contract continues

paymentNotice.sandbox: Test mode: payments on this contract go through a sandbox and no real money moves.
paymentNotice.live: The client pays each stage in advance and Vyapar keeps it safe. It is released to the professional when the client approves the work, or automatically 14 days after the work is sent.
